entries.taskLabel: Bio run Pass 2: Hydramaxx + Activ8EXTRA + Seaweed Secrets + Stimulus + Stimulizer - front zones
entries.notes: Front zones only (71.95m2) as one combined mix in 6-7L water. Delayed October Wk3 bio run for the front (postponed from 25/10 due to wind). Kelpxtra Pass 1 skipped (out of stock); Phosfighter not in stock. Activ8EXTRA included to support recovery from suspected dollar spot (Tombstone Duo sprayed 17/11). Sprayed evening, left on leaf overnight, to be watered in ~4mm at 6am 19/11.

entries.taskLabel: Fungicide: Tombstone Duo + Wetter 600 - front lawn + both strips (patches spreading)
entries.notes: Curative spray at 30mL/100m2 (label dollar spot rate) over 71.95m2: front 10.5mL, strip1 6.24mL, strip2 4.85mL, in 5L water (~7L/100m2) + Wetter 600 surfactant ~0.7mL. Applied evening, foliar, not watered in. Straw spots first seen 24/10 (front Zoysia/Couch edge + both Couch strips), initially treated as fertiliser burn from 18/10 granular; by 15/11 the patches had grown slightly but not spread to new areas, so disease suspected. Counts as November Group 11 fungicide (in place of Heritage Maxx). Re-spray allowed 14-21 days later if still spreading; max 2 consecutive Group 11 sprays then rotate. Wetter 600 not tracked in inventory.

entries.taskLabel: Granular: TX10 (2kg/100m2) - Zoysia front lawn (October Wk1, a week late)
entries.notes: Applied morning via rotary spreader, watered in. Front lawn 35.0m2 at 2kg/100m2. Burn noticed 24/10 at the Zoysia/Couch boundary - likely double dose where TX10 and Maintain overlapped at the edge.

entries.taskLabel: Granular: Maintain (2kg/100m2) - Couch strips only (October Wk1, a week late)
entries.notes: Front Nature Strip 0.416kg + Front Left Strip 0.323kg, watered in. Back lawn skipped (Maintain applied 13/09). Fertiliser burn noticed 24/10 on the Couch strip and Zoysia/Couch edge, base appears dead - repair by top-dress/patching; Activ8EXTRA withheld from burnt patches in the 25/10 bio run.

entries.taskLabel: Main tank-mix: GreenXtra + Tracemaxx + HiCure + Stimulizer - October Wk1 main run (all zones)
entries.notes: Applied morning, foliar only, not watered in. Front zones (front+strip1+strip2, 71.95m2) as one combined mix: GX 143.9, Tmx 71.95, HiCure 107.925, Stiz 2.158mL. Back lawn (68.2m2) separate mix: GX 136.4, Tmx 68.2, HiCure 102.3, Stiz 2.046mL. Back lawn granular skipped this month (Maintain+GroTurf applied 13/09, only 4 weeks prior). Front granular (TX10 front 0.7kg, Maintain strips 0.739kg) pending - evening 11/10 or 12/10.

entries.taskLabel: Spartan pre-emergent + Acelepryn spring grub treatment - back lawn
entries.notes: Back lawn included this season (previously front-only Pass 2 on 30/08). Applied after granular round once tank-mix had dried; watered in via second irrigation pass.

entries.taskLabel: Granular: Maintain (26-1-9) + gypsum + GroTurf - back lawn spring kick-off
entries.notes: Gypsum and GroTurf are ad-hoc additions from existing stock, not tracked in inventory.json (no deduction). Gypsum applied as a soil conditioner to help the diagnosed compaction; GroTurf is old LawnPride stock, ~750g-1kg remaining after this application. Spread via rotary spreader.

entries.taskLabel: Main tank-mix: GreenXtra + Tracemaxx + HiCure + Stimulizer - back lawn spring kick-off
entries.notes: Applied ~12:30pm, foliar only, allowed to dry on leaf before granular round and spray followed. First back lawn application since 30/05/2026; back lawn was held off from the 30/08 front-zone round until mowed.

entries.taskLabel: Spartan pre-emergent + Acelepryn spring grub treatment (Pass 2, post-mow)
entries.notes: Pass 2 of 2 -- front zones only (Front Lawn, Front Nature Strip, Front Left Strip). Acelepryn scoped to front zones only this season (low stock, 0.1L) -- back lawn deferred until back lawn is mowed. Applied same day as mow + Pass 1 tank-mix; watered in immediately per Acelepryn label.

entries.taskLabel: Main tank-mix: GreenXtra + Tracemaxx (reduced) + HiCure + Liquid Iron + Stimulizer (post-mow pre-spring wake-up)
entries.notes: Pass 1 of 2 -- front zones only (Front Lawn, Front Nature Strip, Front Left Strip). Back lawn held off until mowed. Applied after mowing (Zoysia 21mm, Couch 14mm same day). Allowed to dry on leaf, not watered in. Pass 2 (Spartan + Acelepryn) to follow once dry.

entries.taskLabel: Ad-hoc weed control: Tribute + Bow and Arrow + Soil Wetter
entries.notes: Mixed as tank mix diluted in 600mL water. Zoysia + Couch zones only (Tribute zone-locked, never Kikuyu back lawn).

entries.taskLabel: Main tank-mix: GreenXtra + Tracemaxx (reduced) + HiCure + Liquid Iron - pre-winter colour
